kai (acme-poc): Heads up - during our dry run at 08:00 PT we saw a spike of 150rps for ~25s and roughly 9% 503s. Example:

```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 15:00:12 GMT
x-rd-error: capacity_throttle
x-request-id: req_a1b2c3d4
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"capacity_throttle","code":503}
```

marco (sales): Thanks Kai. Are you using the demo route or production route?

kai (acme-poc): demo route bound to poc-456, dedicated pool. We kept fallback off and strict_quality on for the customer's audit.

sophie (support): That config + big burst = recipe for capacity_throttle. We recommend either allowing a visible fallback OR increasing pool headroom.

anas (eng-runtime): Looking at logs for req_a1b2c3d4: 
```
[15:00:12.098] WARN runtime::throttle - capacity_throttle queue_len=37 live_workers=5 max_workers=5
[15:00:12.105] ERROR runtime::scheduler - reject req_a1b2c3d4: no slot
[15:00:12.250] INFO runtime::autoscale - desired=10 current=5 reason="queue_growth"
```

jules (eng-sre): Autoscaler did its job but new instances cold-started ~14s later. We should patch the pre-warm path for that model. For now I can increase burstpool +8 for the demo window.

marco (sales): Customer worried about costs. Can you provide a quick estimate?

sophie (support): For a 30s pre-warm with +8 workers, rough extra cost is ~0.02 of standard hourly pool rate for the POC. I'll DM the exact SKU to the buyer.

kai (acme-poc): If we enable fallback, what model will be used? How will we detect it?

anas (eng-runtime): Fallback targets `gptx-lite-v2` for this model family. Responses include headers `x-rd-fallback: true`, `x-model-variant: gptx-lite-v2`. We can also add body meta if you need visible text in the response.

jules (eng-sre): Temporary mitigation applied: burstpool headroom +8 and cooldown lowered to 6s. Also added pre-warm job scheduled 5m before demo. Monitor console: https://console.redwood.ai/poc-456/pool

kai (acme-poc): Seeing stable responses now. Thanks team. Please add to the POC runbook the clear steps for enabling visible fallback and the cost table.

marco (sales): Will do. Sophie - include a short note to procurement on the cost impact and approvals for pre-warm windows.

scale-bot: policy update on pool poc-456 applied by jules  burstpool_headroom=+8 cooldown_seconds=6 prewarm=true

sophie (support): Closing this thread; I'll follow up with a concise runbook snippet + pricing estimate. :memo:
